changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1 with Machine Pages: a live looper on one track (the LOOP&FADE machine, based on sumedho's RAM Machines 1.3.1) and a crossfader, as one module.
Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; it links to the same image (LF03, fb56201e…) as the locally compiled recipe used for the emulator checks.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
